C0009.title: Game Cheat Developer Wen Sentenced for Automating Unfair Gameplay
C0009.summary: Law enforcement found that Wen developed a game auxiliary script, embedded remote-control software into it, promoted it online, and then remotely controlled players' terminals to steal in-game coins for resale, making over 40,000 yuan illegally. The court found Wen guilty of illegally obtaining computer information system data and sentenced him to three years in prison, suspended for four years, plus a 10,000-yuan fine.
